results.name: Kettlebell Step Up
instructions: Stand facing a bench, holding a kettlebell in each hand with your arms hanging at your sides.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pressing through your heel to lift your body up. Bring your left foot up to meet your right foot on the bench.
Step down with your left foot first, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and your shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Breathe in as you step down and exhale as you step up.
Ensure your whole foot is on the bench when stepping up to avoid slipping.
results.description: Kettlebell Step Up is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Landmine Calf Raise
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder or chest, standing tall.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly and repeat.
tips: Stand on a plate with your heels hanging off for a bigger range.
Keep your knees straight.
results.description: Landmine Calf Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Step one leg behind and across your body into a curtsy position.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
results.description: Landmine Curtsy Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Abductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Glute Kick Back
instructions: Place one foot under the sleeve of the landmine bar on all fours, or stand bent over with the bar behind your foot.
Brace your core.
Kick your leg back and up, lifting the bar with your heel.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Don't arch your lower back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
results.description: Landmine Glute Kick Back is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar close to your chest like a goblet.
Step one leg behind and across your body.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Return to standing and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Keep the bar close to your chest.
Keep your weight on the front heel.
results.description: Landmine Goblet Curtsy Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Abductors.

results.name: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Take a wide step to the side.
Bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the centre and repeat, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your chest up.
Keep your weight in the heel of the bent leg.
results.description: Landmine Goblet Lateral Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Hack Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from the anchor with the end of the bar on your shoulder or held at your chest.
Lean slightly back into the bar with your feet slightly in front of you.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive back up to standing and repeat.
tips: Keep your heels on the floor.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
results.description: Landmine Hack Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest.
Take a wide step to the side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back.
Push off to return to the centre, then switch sides.
tips: Keep the straight leg's foot flat on the floor.
Keep your chest up.
results.description: Landmine Lateral Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Hamstrings.

results.name: Landmine Lunge to Overhead Press
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
As you stand back up, press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the bar to your shoulder and repeat.
tips: Brace your core during the press.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
results.description: Landmine Lunge to Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Triceps, Core.

results.name: Landmine Squat and Press
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your chest with both hands.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up and press the bar forward and up until your arms are straight.
Return the bar to your chest and repeat.
tips: Use your legs to help drive the press.
Keep your chest up in the squat.
results.description: Landmine Squat and Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Triceps, Core.
